From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-10T14:27:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: BlueCrest redlines — proposed consolidated position

Ben / Marissa / Tessa —

Thanks for the context. Attached is RW_Consolidated_Redline_v3.docx with tracked changes and a short concessions list below. I prioritized items that affect legal risk or commercial economics. High-level positions:

1) Data retention / residency — propose a 90-day default retention with customer-selectable retention up to 12 months on paid plan; we will not accept unilateral deletion obligations that conflict with lawful access requests.

2) Subprocessors — accept list-based disclosure plus 30-day notice for material changes; require standard flowdown for security obligations, but carve out kernel-level infra providers (we operate on partner GPU fleets) with SOC2 attestation requirement.

3) SLA credits — clarify computation: credits apply to per-request latency SLOs at the route/model level and will be prorated; batching does not alter credit calculation but does change expectation on tail latency — added explicit example in Exhibit B.

4) Termination for convenience — willing to allow for order form limited TFC (90 days notice) but with 30% early termination fee if termination occurs within first 6 months of the renewal term (to protect committed capacity).

5) Pricing / burst treatment — propose burst invoiced at a defined overage rate (1.8x committed unit price) for first 60 days of uplift, then normalize to committed pricing after onboarding verification.

I’ve also annotated the order form to preserve our indemnities and limit on consequential damages. Please review the tracked doc and confirm any commercial tradeoffs you need me to escalate to Revenue Ops / Execs.

Tessa — I added a short rollout appendix; confirm that staging schedule (20% month 1, +10% month 2, +0–10% month 3 depending on telemetry) maps to CS runbooks.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RW_Consolidated_Redline_v3.docx (docx)]
